name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the second sentence, 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box', is not captured. Add a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box): it requires holding_box on the exit step (at_exit is a last-step-only condition, so the clause closes when the agent is on the exit while carrying the box). The existing ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) correctly captures the 'very next move' requirement and is rule-only-valid, so keep it; only the Response clause is missing.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'the very next move must pick it up again', and Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures 'if you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box' (at_exit is only an if-condition, correctly given no Existence). The rule-only warning is valid since both are conditionals.
